purpose: Summative artifact applying D2.1 + D2.2 across 5 mini-experiments. Used as Lesson 5 capstone evidence.
student_learning_goal: I can predict, test, and tell if my prediction was right.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can predict, test, and tell if my prediction was right.
header.character_watermark: Lucky and Mae together in lab coats in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in combined). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Predict 5 coin flips. Then flip a real coin and record results.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-column 5-row prediction table for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet. Header: 'Predict' and 'Result'. 5 rows for H/T entries. Above the table, a small coin icon labelled 'COIN' (~0.6in).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_COIN at Part 1: instructions ask the child to predict and test coin flips. Keywords name the visual element and activity.

parts.answer_key: Any 5 predictions paired with 5 actual flip results.

parts.student_instructions: Bag has 4 RED + 1 BLUE marble. Predict 5 pulls. Then pull and record (replace each marble!).
parts.visual_layout: Top: a marble bag illustration (4 red, 1 blue). Below: 2-column 5-row table for predictions and results.

image_placeholders.description: A marble pull layout for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet. Top: an open bag with 4 red marbles + 1 blue marble visible (each ~0.5in). Below: a 2-column 5-row prediction table with header 'Predict' and 'Result'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_MARBLES at Part 2: instructions ask the child to predict and test marble pulls. Keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Most predictions = RED (more likely 4 of 5). Results may vary; both columns should reflect actual pulls. Most pulls should be red over time.

parts.student_instructions: Sort 6 events as IMPOSSIBLE, POSSIBLE, or CERTAIN. Then write: 'I predicted ___ and the result was ___.'
parts.visual_layout: Top: 6 event cards arranged in a sort area with 3 destination columns (I/P/C). Below: a sentence-frame writing line.

image_placeholders.description: A sort + summary layout for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet. Top: 6 small event cards (each ~2in × 0.6in) listed and 3 column areas labelled IMPOSSIBLE / POSSIBLE / CERTAIN where the child writes the events. Below: a single sentence-frame line 'I predicted ___ and the result was ___.'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_SORT_SUMMARY at Part 3: instructions ask the child to sort 6 events and write a sentence. Keywords name the activity (sort) and items (events).

parts.answer_key: Sort: distribute 6 events into 3 columns appropriately (2 each ideally). Summary: any sentence using 'predicted' and 'result' from any of the experiments.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, predict tomorrow's weather. Tell why.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone — summative evidence. Score against the rubric. Look for: predictions made BEFORE results (Part 1, 2); use of likelihood reasoning (Part 2); valid sort across 3 categories (Part 3); coherent summary sentence (Part 3).
